subject: OvmfPkg/VirtioRngDxe: protect VirtioRngGetRNG against timer callbacks
reasons: This is a one-off concurrency fix in a single function.
The change adds a TPL guard around one RNG path instead of applying a reusable structural rewrite.
There is no repeated before/after pattern across multiple call sites or files.
Coccinelle is a poor fit for a localized race fix.
